headline: Verbal Jint hosts beer listening party for new album
sub: '10 Years of Misreading II' lands Dec 1, 14 years after Part I
caption:
Verbal Jint is throwing a draft beer listening party before his new album drops.

'10 Years of Misreading II' (10년동안의오독 II), the sequel to his 2012 album, comes out Dec 1. On Nov 29 at 8 PM KST, he'll play the album for 20 fans at a billiards hall in Geumho-dong, Seoul, and share behind-the-scenes stories for each track. Adult fans (19+) apply via DM to his manager's Instagram; winners are drawn at random.

📌 Source: Sports Kyunghyang, Ilgan Sports (via Korean media)
